headword: {高級|こうきゅう}{料亭|りょうてい}
reading: こうきゅうりょうてい
gloss: high-class Japanese restaurant; exclusive traditional dining establishment

definitions.gloss: high-class Japanese restaurant; exclusive traditional dining establishment
definitions.explanation: An upscale traditional Japanese restaurant offering elaborate multi-course meals in a refined, private setting, often with tatami rooms and a garden.

examples.english: I dined at a high-class Japanese restaurant.

examples.english: High-class restaurants are often used for business entertainment.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧ (high-class; luxury) + ⟦{料亭|りょうてい}→料亭：21710_ryoutei⟧ (traditional Japanese restaurant). A ⟦{料亭|りょうてい}→料亭：21710_ryoutei⟧ is already an upscale establishment, so the addition of ⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧ emphasizes the top tier — places with famous chefs, exquisite gardens, and often a policy of refusing first-time guests (⟦{一見|いちげん}さん→一見さん：16186_ichigensan⟧お{断|ことわ}り).

CULTURAL NOTE:
These establishments are closely associated with Japanese business culture and politics. They serve as venues for ⟦{接待|せったい}→接待：12903_settai⟧ (business entertainment), confidential meetings, and high-profile gatherings. Prices are rarely displayed, and bills can reach hundreds of thousands of yen per person.
